    APEX / TRACK LAB

    Unofficial fan game. Procedural cars and simulated handling.

    TAKE THE GRID WITH YOU

    Install APEX

    Android: open this site in Chrome, then choose Install app from its menu.

    PC: use Chrome or Edge and choose the install icon in the address bar.

    iPhone: open this site in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Open as Web App if offered.

    Offline files are being prepared. Multiplayer and chat require internet.

    Installation requires a hosted HTTPS address or localhost. A downloaded HTML file cannot be installed this way.

    YOUR FIRST LAP

    Find your racing line.

    1. Shape your circuit.

      Draw a loop, or choose a preset. Switch to Edit nodes to move corners. Double-click to add a point. The loop closes automatically.

    2. Choose your machine.

      Pick a season from 2000–2026 and select a car. Shapes, colors, sound and performance vary by era.

    3. Chase a clean lap.

      W / ↑ accelerates. S / ↓ brakes, then reverses. A D / ← → steers. C changes the camera. R returns to the grid. Esc pauses. Touch controls appear on small screens.

    Follow the starting direction and pass every checkpoint in order. Grass reduces grip. Tracks and records are saved in this browser.

    THE CAR ARCHIVE

    27 seasons of racing.

    The chassis names represent real cars. Original procedural models use representative team colors and era-specific shapes, wings and cockpit details. These are simplified interpretations, not exact replicas or photorealistic scans.

    Handling is tuned for this game, not based on official telemetry. This fan project is not affiliated with Formula 1 or any team.
